posts.name: Comrade Bubbles
posts.cooked:
The Scholar has no trash to take a card from.

John Rhodes turns to the purple squirrel perched in thin air. "Move, little one. I need that ley-line." He waits patiently and then strums a seemingly-invisble string. A pure note rings out in the twisted void of the Realm of Discord and a line of fire streaks towards the crew of the floating time-ship and the unnatural abomination stalking them. The fire strikes each target before rebounding towards the Scholar and he is visibly restored as he flicks his fingers towards the hull of the time-ship and a blast of energy sunders it in twain. He merely glances at the glowing blade by his side and it darts forwards, towards its target.

The Scholar

HP:  13

Hand:  Don’t Dismiss Anything, Bring What You Need, Transmutive Recovery, “Get Out of the Way!”, Expect the Worst

In Play: Mortal Form to Energy

Trash: N/A

-/-

Play a Card: “Get Out of the Way!” 1 Fire damage to each non-hero target - La Capitan [68] (Time Corsair), La Paradoja Magnifica [3], Battle Forged [3], Chip [5], Siege-Breaker [8](-1), Final Breath [8], L'Epeiste [5], Trueshot [8], The Amazing Mable [4], Portal Fiend [16] 

 The Scholar regains 9HP [22] and Mortal Form triggers targeting LPM for 9 [-6]

Use a Power: Cosmic Weapon: Battle-Forged [0]

Draw a Card:  Transmutive Recovery

End of Turn: N/A

-/-

HP:  22

Hand:  Don’t Dismiss Anything, Bring What You Need, Transmutive Recovery, Truth Seeker, Transmutive Recovery

In Play: Mortal Form to Energy

Trash: Expect the Worst, “Get Out of the Way!”

Effects:  Cosmic Weapon HP (4) {Construct} [Power: This Hero Deals 1 target 3 energy Damage.] (Source: Captain Cosmic) – This is here so I don’t forget

Mortal Form to Energy – Discard a card at the start of the Scholar’s turn. Whenever the Scholar heals, deal 1 target that much energy damage.

-/-

Comments: That should give us some breathing room.

 

Again, I think everything is correct. I would assume that my card play gives 4 constructs and Tempest a heal with Tempest gaining one hp.

- At the end of the villain turn, Siege-Breaker deals the two hero targets with the highest HP 3 irreducible Fire damage each. (Siege Breaker)
- At the end of the villain turn, Final Breath deals the hero target with the lowest HP 3 Toxic damage. (Final Breath)
